app.name: Mi Diario
app.tagline: Your meals, your places, your memories.

validation.placeRequired: Pick a place or create a new one.
validation.passwordTooShort: It must be at least 8 characters.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: We couldn't show this screen. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be broken, or the entry may no longer exist.

repository.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for. It may have been deleted.
repository.conflict: That is still being used somewhere else.
repository.invalid: Some of the data isn't valid. Check it and try again.
repository.quota_exceeded: Your browser storage is full. Delete an entry with photos or use smaller photos.
repository.unavailable: We couldn't connect. Please try again in a moment.
repository.unauthorized: We couldn't start your session. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, let us know.
repository.unknown: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
repository.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
repository.email_not_confirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Check your inbox (and spam).
repository.email_taken: There's already an account with that email. Try signing in.
repository.weak_password: That password is too weak. Try a longer or harder one.
repository.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.

journal.title: Your journal
journal.subtitle: Add the meals you've liked the most

empty.title: Your journal is waiting for its first meal
empty.body: Snap that delicious thing, pick how it was, and done: it's saved in under 30 seconds.
empty.tip1: Log bodegones, wineries and street stalls.
empty.tip2: Flag unusual finds so you can find them later.
empty.tip3: Share your favorites with the people you love.
